predicates.J_reveal_affair: Tells Nick about Tom's extramarital affair.
predicates.N_dinner: Visits the Buchanans at their home.
predicates.G_green_light: Stands alone on the lawn, gazing toward the green light across the bay.
predicates.T_assault: Injures Myrtle during the apartment party.
predicates.N_apartment_party: Attends Tom and Myrtle's apartment party.
predicates.G_introduce: Introduces himself to Nick at the party and approaches him.
predicates.N_gatsby_party: Attends a party at Gatsby's mansion.
predicates.G_background: Tells Nick about his background over lunch.
predicates.J_backstory: Tells Nick about Gatsby and Daisy's past love and Gatsby's wish to reunite with her; the events of 1917 are the content of this telling.
predicates.N_arrange: Makes arrangements in advance for Gatsby and Daisy to reunite.
predicates.G_reunite: Participates in the reunion with Daisy.
predicates.D_reunite: Participates in the reunion with Gatsby.
predicates.D_affair_begins: Begins an extramarital affair with Gatsby after their reunion.
predicates.G_demands: Demands that Daisy declare she has never loved Tom.
predicates.D_admits: Admits that she has loved Tom as well as Gatsby.
predicates.T_sends_home: Tells Gatsby to take Daisy home.
predicates.M_collision: Dies when struck by the car on its return journey.
predicates.D_driving: Drives Gatsby's car on the return journey; this driving interval includes the collision.
predicates.G_reveals_driver: Tells Nick that Daisy was driving and says he is willing to take responsibility for her.
predicates.N_urges_flee: Urges Gatsby to leave to avoid being pursued over the incident.
predicates.T_identifies_owner: Tells George Wilson that Gatsby owns the car involved in the collision.
predicates.W_misidentifies: Forms the mistaken belief that Gatsby was his wife's lover.
predicates.G_killed: Is shot dead by Wilson at the swimming pool.
predicates.H_funeral: Attends the funeral of his son, Gatsby.
predicates.N_refuses_handshake: Initially refuses to shake Tom's hand when they meet again.
predicates.T_admits_telling: Admits to Nick that he previously told Wilson that Gatsby owned the car involved in the collision.
predicates.N_final_green_light: Returns to Gatsby's mansion before leaving and looks toward the green light across the bay.
